build.title: Jet aircraft
build.summary: Source-constrained reconstruction candidate. Read the independent evidence before building.

stages.title: Build body bay 1 upright
stages.instruction: Join three square tiles into an open triangular ring. Stack the next ring on its three matching edges. The creator supports the upright assembly; its first clear hands-off checkpoint is the horizontal pose.

stages.title: Build body bay 2 upright
stages.instruction: Join three square tiles into an open triangular ring. Stack the next ring on its three matching edges. The creator supports the upright assembly; its first clear hands-off checkpoint is the horizontal pose.

stages.title: Build body bay 3 upright
stages.instruction: Join three square tiles into an open triangular ring. Stack the next ring on its three matching edges. The creator supports the upright assembly; its first clear hands-off checkpoint is the horizontal pose.

stages.title: Build body bay 4 upright
stages.instruction: Join three square tiles into an open triangular ring. Stack the next ring on its three matching edges. The creator supports the upright assembly; its first clear hands-off checkpoint is the horizontal pose.

stages.title: Lay the body on its keel
stages.instruction: Turn the four connected triangular bays onto the long keel. Adjust as shown in the source and release for the balance check.

stages.title: Make and attach the three-triangle nose
stages.instruction: Join the three long blue isosceles triangles into a point. Attach all three short bases around the front triangular opening.

stages.title: Make a wing pod beside the body
stages.instruction: Join its two squares at a right angle and add the two right-triangle end caps. Keep the third long side open.

stages.title: Seat the wing pod against the body
stages.instruction: Hold the pod against the middle body bay, matching its top edge. The exact seating remains unresolved; this step is not certified buildable.

stages.title: Make a wing pod beside the body
stages.instruction: Join its two squares at a right angle and add the two right-triangle end caps. Keep the third long side open.

stages.title: Seat the wing pod against the body
stages.instruction: Hold the pod against the middle body bay, matching its top edge. The exact seating remains unresolved; this step is not certified buildable.

stages.title: Add the red leading panels
stages.instruction: Seat each red equilateral triangle along the front edge of its pod.

stages.title: Add the blue outer wingtips
stages.instruction: Join one right triangle to each outer roof edge, preserving the mirrored sweep.

stages.title: Close the tail point
stages.instruction: Join the three red equilateral triangles into a point and seat around the rear opening.

stages.title: Attach the horizontal tail first
stages.instruction: Join the two orange horizontal stabilizers to the rear bay. Keep their outer edges clear.

stages.title: Put the upright fins on the tail
stages.instruction: Attach each purple equilateral fin above its horizontal stabilizer, following the source ordering.

stages.title: Build and seat the cockpit module
stages.instruction: Join the two purple long triangles to the yellow divider; add the green right triangles and red front floor. Seat the six-piece module on the forward body. The hidden bottom joins require further reconstruction.
